people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Ner
people.line: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.

translations.web: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”
translations.bsb: When Joab and all his troops arrived, he was informed, “Abner son of Ner came to see the king, who sent him on his way in peace.”
translations.kjv: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
translations.asv: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
